tei:div.tei:p: 99) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur pa drag sgrub kyi cha lag sngon 'gro bzhugs: 100)na mo padma kā ra ye:

o rgyan he ru ka la 'dud: drag po las kyi sbyor ba'i thabs: sngon 'gro'i las chog 'di ru bkod: gtor skyems sbyangs spel sngags kyis bsgyur: ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlab bya: de nas gser skyems 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo skyabs gnas dam pa'i mchog: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum: 'dren pa kun gyi gzhir gyur khyed rnams la: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul bzhes: phrin las gang brtsam 'bad med 'grub par mdzod: brgyud gsum bla ma theg dgu'i yi dam lha: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul bzhes: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dbyings dang dbyings bzhugs sku gsum rgyal ba rnams: thugs rje'i mthu mnga' mkhyen cing gzigs pa yi: sras bcas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la: bdud rtsi= mngon spyod= khyad par ye shes phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: sprul 'khor bka' sdod pho nya sgo skyong tshogs: 101)bdud rtsi= mngon spyod= sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' dam la gnas pa'i: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang: dkar phyogs skyong mdzad lha mgon thams cad la: bdud rtsi= mngon spyod= log 'dren dgra bgegs 'gugs bsgral las mdzod cig: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes brjod skyems gtor gtsang sar mchod: de yis las kun 'grub 'gyur ro: de nas mkhyen gzu ni: kyai: gson cig dgongs shig mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag: sku gsum rgyal ba sras bcas gzu dang dpang: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma= yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams= ma rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho= chos srung dam can gter bdag= khyed rnams mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i spyan ma rtul: bdag ni ma lan byang chub bsgrub pa la: dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams kyis sgrub ma ster: bstan pa'i sgron me gsal ba'i 'od po che:

dam nyams dgra bo 'di yis bsnub par brtsams: bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' bcag thugs kyang dkrugs: bsam gtan sems sun dben gnas 102)gnyen po bcom: dge ba'i tshogs bcag dge 'dun 'dus gral bshig: nyes med sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byed: thabs rnams du mas mi dge sna tshogs bsags: de 'dra'i las ngan dgra bgegs sdig can rnams: mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis ma bsgral na: bstan pa rin chen sgron me ji ltar byed: kho yang las kyi rnam smin mthu btsan pas: duḥkha'i gnas su yun ring sdug re bsngal: mkhyen ldan brtse chen rnams kyis dgongs mdzod la: bdag gi mgon skyabs gzu dang dpang du bzhugs: zhing bcu'i ru tra 'gugs bsgral dus la babs: thugs dam ma g.yel drag po'i phrin las mdzod: ces brjod phud skyems gtsang sar mchod: de yis mngon spyod phrin las 'grub: skal ldan bu yi dpal du shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: gter gyi srung mas gnyer gyis shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang kho mo bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bgyis pa'o// dge'o//
